conversations.description: Conversations with a question in the month.

cost.description: The chat agent's model calls, in the base currency, exact.

cost_per_conversation.description: Cost over conversations, rounded once to four places by RND-DISPLAY; absent with no conversation.

failed.description: The AI service did not finish.

reads_refused.description: Reads refused or failed: tool errors.

refused.description: Stopped with a code: a limit, the switch, a budget, screening.

regenerated.description: Answers that failed the figures' check once and were asked for again (AI-08): grounding failures.

screening_flags.description: Turns screening stopped, and reads whose text it withheld (AI-P7).

withheld.description: Figures or words withheld because they still failed the check.
